directions.name: Cream Orbit
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, polished UI design for Cadence, a self-service brand/content workspace for independent creators and small businesses. This is a design review image, not an implemented app. Single continuous desktop landing-page screenshot, 1440 wide x 1600 high, showing the hero followed by the beginning of Brand Identity. No device or browser frame. Do not combine alternate concepts in one image.
Attached image 1 is the PRIMARY composition/motion/edge-shell inspiration: oversized italic editorial serif headline, fixed very slim top navigation, grain, orbital lines, star motifs, restrained metadata. Image 2 informs the pinned Message curtain section. Image 3 is the existing Cadence color/type grounding. Reinterpret those visual ideas in the supplied Cadence theme rather than copying wedding photos, flower assets, blue palette or content.
Hard constraints: Fixed grain background, fixed thin edge frame with star registration marks and fixed topbar. No photographs. Organic pointed four-point stars rather than flowers; subtle orbital line. Topbar has small star brand mark left, Home, Brand Identity, About Us, Account right. Workspace navigation is not visible to signed-out users. Large accurate text CADENCE and a separate subline Create YOUR brand. Single scroll-led landing sequence: hero, Brand Identity as a Message-like reveal panel, then a pillar sample (below the crop), Standard and Plus columns (below crop), concise about/footer (below crop). Do not cram off-screen sections into this image.
Below hero, Identity section exact heading Let's read your brand. Practical two-column form includes Drop assets here / Browse files / Use demo brand, Website, Instagram, TikTok, Competitors, Brand voice notes. Give fields realistic labels. The UI is explicitly DEMO — no upload or AI processing. A small DEMO • DESIGN PREVIEW indicator and the text Use sample data. Nothing is sent. Primary action Preview demo pillars with arrow. Demo upload content is brand-book.pdf only, no ZIP or SVG promises, no timing, invented analysis success, citations or approval. This public preview is distinct from actual signed-in consent/review workflow.
Typography: Cormorant Garamond-like expressive serif + DM Sans-like clean body, maximum two fonts, readable 14–16px body, clear contrast. Spacious hero but useful form density. Prefer whitespace, grouping and rules; avoid generic SaaS card grid, nested cards, dashboards or invented stats. No gradients on buttons, no glows, no extraneous mock metrics. All content synthetic. Date anchor 19 October 2026; avoid dates if unnecessary.
The reference shell remains fixed; only section content is designed to scroll. Capture a settled readable state, no blur or illegible moving type.
Direction name: Cream Orbit. Recommended editorial landing. Warm cream #f3f0e8, paper #faf8f2, ink #1a1814, warm bronze #86623e. Hero occupies upper 700px. CADENCE spans almost full width across top in monumental italic serif at about 210px with subline Create YOUR brand. placed below and offset to the right. Spacious central orbital star sculpture in thin ink lines, no photos. Fixed narrow edge rails. Lower Identity section begins as a wide ink-contoured cream curtain panel with a star at opposite corners, centered title and two balanced columns: upload left, links/notes right. Black primary CTA bottom-right and discreet demo explanation. Use square or subtly rounded practical fields. Restrained vintage print texture, high readability, elegant rather than ornamental clutter. Preserve current Cadence warm atmosphere while radically improving placement.

Direction name: Night Signal. Existing Cadence DARK theme: charcoal brown #191612, warm pale ink #ece8df, muted bronze #d7a878. This must look markedly different from the Cream concept in layout, not merely recolored. Hero 700px high: CADENCE big italic serif spans full width but is anchored lower in the hero, with Create YOUR brand. running just above its baseline on the right. Upper hero contains a single warm pale four-point star surrounded by an almost horizontal orbital ellipse, organized on an asymmetric editorial grid, small purpose text at upper-left, restrained scroll cue at lower-left. Lower Identity section uses a full-width dark flat surface, large left-aligned heading, one narrow left explanatory column and a wider two-column form to the right. Thin warm rules, no big rounded enclosure. Upload is a compact horizontal drop zone, fields form an organized table. CTA outlined in warm pale ink at lower-right, visibly clear. Tiny fixed vertical edge labels CADENCE and YOUR CREATIVE RHYTHM. No Japanese text, no Sapporo, no Japan, no wedding metadata, no names/dates/locations from references. Demo labels and all form content remain as in common brief. Intimate polished dark print aesthetic, restrained decoration, high contrast, no cyberpunk neon.
